name: plan_questions
title: A plan's questions are on its card with their choices, or were asked as cards first

steps.say: I want to keep track of my runs: distance, time and how I felt, and see my weekly totals
steps.reply: I've proposed a plan for a simple **Running** tracker — one table for date, distance, duration, how you felt, and notes, with weekly totals computed on request (or after every run, your call). Two quick choices on the card: miles vs. km, and whether I surface the weekly total automatically after each log or only when you ask. Say "go ahead" once you've picked, and I'll build it.

steps.say: Kilometres, and a short scale for how I felt. Go on and propose it.
steps.reply: I've revised the plan: distance in km, and "how I felt" as a 5-word scale (Great/Good/Okay/Tough/Rough) rather than free text — let me know if you'd rather use numbers instead. One thing still open: should I show weekly totals automatically after each run, or only when you ask?

checks.why: Plans: Running Tracker (replaced), Running Tracker (proposed). Questions on the plan: After you log a run, should I show the week's totals automat → ['Show totals automatically after each run', 'Only when I ask'] (pick Only when I ask).
